items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The top act in there was a girl named Caroline Snowden, that had a chorus, and she could sing and dance.

ctx.x: That Cotton Club started in the early Twenties, and it was out in Culver City. The top act in there was a girl named Caroline Snowden, that had a chorus, and she could sing and dance. At that time, that was the place to go.
I was going to ask you a bit about the Cotton Club, but for some reason I was thinking it was a bit later. I thought it started about 1928. But it started before that.
